What changed:
- **Definition:** the function in `userlib/core.py` is now `fetch_user_name`. Its body is the same.
- **Imports and calls:** `userlib/feature_0.py` through `feature_7.py` now import and call `fetch_user_name`, still alongside `get_user_name_legacy`.
- `userlib/__init__.py` didn't refer to the function, so I left it alone.

A search finds no remaining `get_user_name` outside `get_user_name_legacy`. No logic changed, but the project has no tests, so I didn't run the functions to compare their output.

The old name is gone. If any code outside `userlib` still calls `get_user_name`, it will break; adding `get_user_name = fetch_user_name` to `core.py` would keep it working.
